Victory

How to play

Setup & turn

Each deck splits into a unit pile and a gear pile. Draw 3 units + 3 gear. At turn start, refill each side of your hand to 3, then roll 2d6. Higher initiative roll goes first.

Playing cards

Each die plays ONE card with value ≤ that die. Drag a card onto your side's glowing slots (or click it, then click a slot). Units go to UNIT slots (max 3 in play). Power/Shield attach to one of your units (one of each per unit) — drop them on that column's POWER/SHIELD slot. You may reroll either or both dice once, before playing any card. If a valid play exists after the final roll, you must make at least one before attacking or ending the turn. Cards can only be played on your own side.

Doubles

Rolling doubles triggers your deck power once that turn, before normal plays — use it or decline it. A new double after a reroll can trigger the power again.

Attacking

Each unit attacks once per turn. Declaring your first attack ends card plays. Click one of your units, then click an enemy unit. Hero attacking Follower: the follower is destroyed (hero rule). Hero vs Hero: higher value wins, tie destroys both. Follower attacking: destroys lower-value units, tie destroys both — a follower can never beat a hero. Power adds its value to the attack. Shield absorbs the hit and breaks instead of the unit.

Winning

After your roll, you are eliminated if you have no units in play, no playable unit in hand, and no units left in your unit pile. You get one LAST CHANCE ROLL first. Last army standing wins.

Aggro — Knights of the Blade · Fury of the Machines

On doubles, destroy an enemy unit with value at or below the doubles value.

Tempo — Creatures of the Deep · Guardians of the Wild

On doubles, summon a unit from your hand or unit pile with value at or below the doubles value. The pile is shuffled after.

Sustain — Children of the Night · Warriors of the Light

On doubles, summon a unit from your discard pile with value at or below the doubles value.

Control — Masters of the Arcane · Reapers of the Soul

On doubles, destroy an enemy Power/Shield with value at or below the doubles value, OR play a Power/Shield from your hand, gear pile, or discard (≤ doubles value) onto one of your units.

Truce rule

Not included in this VR prototype.
